layout.platformText: A unified platform for search, monitoring, and analytics.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to continue to your workspace.

register.title: Create account
register.description: Create your account to get started.
register.loginRule: Use Latin letters, numbers, spaces and . ' - only

forgotPassword.title: Password recovery
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email to receive a reset link.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.description: Set a new password for your account.

confirmPassword.title: Confirm your password
confirmPassword.description: Please confirm your password to continue.

verifyEmail.title: Verify email
verifyEmail.description: Please confirm your email address to continue.
verifyEmail.intro: We sent a verification email to the address linked to your account. Confirm it to unlock the full workspace and protected sections of the platform.
verifyEmail.hint: If you do not see the message right away, check your spam or promotions folder. After confirmation, you can continue working without restrictions.
verifyEmail.statusMessage: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.
verifyEmail.stepInboxText: Open the latest message from Uraboros and make sure you are using the same email you registered with.
verifyEmail.stepConfirmText: Follow the verification link from the email to confirm that the address really belongs to you.
verifyEmail.stepResendText: If the email expired or never arrived, request a fresh verification message with one click.
verifyEmail.actionText: Use the button below to request a new email. For security, keep only the latest verification message and use the newest link.

authCode.title: Authentication code
authCode.description: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

recoveryCode.title: Recovery code
recoveryCode.description: Enter one of your recovery codes to continue.
